parent_objective: implement old-key-aware exact repair/projection without PPO

public_gates: infrastructure implementation only; no PPO run
old-key preference corpus validates without privileged actor inputs
exact repair remains backward-compatible when old-key corpus is absent
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden parameters or oracle labels to actor inputs
do not replace closed-loop old-key replay gates with the surrogate
hypothesis: An optional old-key preference corpus and old-key surrogate loss can be added to exact post-PPO repair while preserving existing repair behavior when disabled.
success_criteria: old-key preference corpus module exports and validates NPZ/metadata artifacts
exact_post_ppo_repair accepts optional old-key corpus arguments
selection trace records old-key surrogate metrics when enabled
failure_criteria: existing exact repair behavior changes when old-key corpus is omitted
old-key corpus includes privileged actor inputs
